description: Determine each player's Primary Mission from their Force Dispositions, per Warhammer 40,000 11th Edition Matched Play. Each player's mission is looked up from their OPPONENT's Force Disposition — in a non-mirror matchup, the two players get different missions.

opponent_disposition.description: Your opponent's Force Disposition, selected when mustering.

your_disposition.description: Your army's Force Disposition, selected when mustering.

name: determine_primary_mission
